name: TP-Link Kasa smart plug
description: Turns TP-Link Kasa smart plugs and power strips on and off, and reports what they are doing.
notes: It opens a port to listen for plugs even when it is given one address, so it needs listen. Scanning the network for plugs is turned off, because that would need the whole local network: type the plug's address instead. Proven against a stand-in that speaks the Kasa protocol, not yet a real plug.
